message: The other day, we had a surprise thunderstorm roll in, and let me tell you, we were not ready! 🌧️ I scrambled to find our go-bags, only to discover they were still in the closet, buried under last summer's beach towels. In the chaos, I grabbed snacks instead of essentials—my kids were thrilled, but I was left wondering how to keep us dry with a bag of popcorn and a juice box! It was a comical reminder that preparedness isn’t just about the big stuff; it’s also about those little moments when we realize we’re not quite as ready as we thought. At least we can laugh about it now! Have you ever had a moment like that?
